This is the i40e equivalent of commit c762dff24c06 (""ixgbe: Look up MAC
address in Open Firmware or IDPROM"").
As with that fix
column2: attempt to look up the MAC address in Open Firmware

column1: on systems that support it
column2: and use IDPROM on SPARC if no OF address

column1: is found.
In the case of the i40e there is an assumption that the default mac
address has already been set up as the primary mac filter on probe
so if this filter is obtained from the Open Firmware or IDPROM
explicit write is needed via i40e_aq_mac_address_write() and
i40e_aq_add_macvlan() invocation.
The I40E_FLAG_PF_MAC flag in the platform-private i40e_pf structure
tracks whether a platform-specific mac address was found
case calls to i40e_aq_mac_address_write() and i40e_aq_add_macvlan()
will be triggered.
